During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' led at least two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s on a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] resembling [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. One of the [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 2 (discharge report)|B1 battle droids]] under his command; however, ended up blasting the head off another [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 1 (discharge report)|B1 droid]] due to a programming glitch, causing the OOM droid to clutch its face in exasperation and presumably file another suboptimal weapon discharge report, which it had done at least one day prior.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The OOM command battle droid appeared in an artwork by [[John Van Fleet]] in the [[2012]] guidebook ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', titled "Another day, another suboptimal weapon discharge report." According to author [[Jason Fry]] in his endnotes, it was one of the last artworks issued for the book, as well as the best in his opinion. He also considered doing a victory report via vocoder as a caption.<ref name="Endnotes 6">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}}</ref>
